description: Manages various lookup and reference data such as currencies, countries, partners, organizational units, and other system-wide static values.

endpoints.name: GetCurrencies
endpoints.description: Retrieves a list of all available currencies.
example_uses: Show me all the currencies supported by the system.
I need a list of currency codes and names.
What are the available currencies for financial transactions?
endpoints.when_to_use: When you need a comprehensive list of currency codes and names for display or selection.

endpoints.name: GetEligibleEntities
endpoints.description: Retrieves a list of entities that are eligible for certain operations or classifications.
example_uses: List all entities that are eligible for funding.
Which entities can participate in this program?
Provide a list of eligible organizational entities.
endpoints.when_to_use: When you need to identify or select from a predefined list of eligible entities.

endpoints.name: GetCountries
endpoints.description: Retrieves a list of all countries.
example_uses: Show me all the countries.
I need a list of country names and codes.
What are the available countries for address selection?
endpoints.when_to_use: When you need a comprehensive list of countries for display, selection, or validation.

endpoints.name: GetApplicationTypes
endpoints.description: Retrieves a list of all defined application types.
example_uses: What are the different types of applications?
List all available application categories.
Show me the application types for new submissions.
endpoints.when_to_use: When you need to know the various categories or types of applications supported by the system.

endpoints.name: GetPartners
endpoints.description: Retrieves a list of all registered partners.
example_uses: List all our current partners.
Who are the partners we collaborate with?
Show me the full list of partner organizations.
endpoints.when_to_use: When you need a complete list of all partners in the system.

endpoints.name: GetOrganizationUnits
endpoints.description: Retrieves a list of all organizational units within the system.
example_uses: Show me all the organizational units.
List the departments and divisions.
What are the available organizational structures?
endpoints.when_to_use: When you need a list of internal organizational units for reporting, assignment, or filtering.

endpoints.name: GetLiaisonOffices
endpoints.description: Retrieves a list of all liaison offices.
example_uses: List all liaison offices.
Where are our liaison offices located?
Show me the contact details for liaison offices.
endpoints.when_to_use: When you need to identify or select from a list of liaison offices.

endpoints.name: GetContacts
endpoints.description: Retrieves a list of all contacts.
example_uses: List all contacts in the system.
Who are the registered contacts?
Show me the full list of contact persons.
endpoints.when_to_use: When you need a complete list of all contacts in the system.

endpoints.name: GetUsers
endpoints.description: Retrieves a list of all system users.
example_uses: List all registered users.
Who has access to the system?
Show me the full list of user accounts.
endpoints.when_to_use: When you need a complete list of all system users for administration or reporting.

endpoints.name: GetGeminiModels
endpoints.description: Retrieves a list of available Gemini AI models.
example_uses: What Gemini models are available?
List the AI models I can use.
Show me the supported Gemini versions.
endpoints.when_to_use: When you need to know which Gemini AI models are configured and available for use.
